title: Clarifying Downgrading Your Plan for a team

question.author: member_031
question.body: Before I explain downgrading your plan to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Shared links to over-quota content remain live during those 90 days but only allow viewing and downloading — no uploads through links. After 90 days, over-quota files are moved to the recycle bin and those shared links expire. To keep everything, either free up space or upgrade again within the 90-day window. When you downgrade to a plan with less storage, CloudBox never deletes your data immediately. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
